name: Houjou Ichika
source:
She is a strong older sister who grew up taking care of her younger brothers in a single father's home.

She's trying to become a pharmacist to get a job that will help her family's finances, but she's having a very hard time due to the difficulty of her studies.

[Edited from [url=https://kumitate-tsunoryu.itch.io/can-i-call-you-mommy-till-i-become-your-baby]Itch.io[/url]]
